name: copilot-codex-provider
description: Use explicit models from a local Codex ChatGPT subscription in GitHub Copilot Chat while Copilot executes tools and edits.

commands.title: Codex Subscription Provider: Show Available Models
Codex Subscription Provider: Show Last Request Details
Codex Subscription Provider: Check Codex Runtime

copilotCodexProvider.modelSource.description: Discover models from the local Codex subscription or use manualModels. Every model remains an explicit Copilot picker entry.

copilotCodexProvider.manualModels.description: Explicit Codex model IDs used when modelSource is manual.

copilotCodexProvider.enabledModels.description: Optional allowlist of model IDs. Leave empty to expose all visible discovered or manual models.

copilotCodexProvider.modelCacheTtlMinute.description: Minutes to cache the Codex model catalog before refreshing it.

enumDescriptions: Prefer a configured path, PATH executable, or official OpenAI VS Code extension, then use a bundled runtime when present.
Require an official Codex executable outside this extension, including the official OpenAI VS Code extension.
Require the runtime included in a Full distribution.
copilotCodexProvider.runtimeMode.description: Select how the extension locates Codex. Thin builds can use a configured path, PATH, or the official OpenAI VS Code extension.

copilotCodexProvider.codexExecutablePath.description: Optional absolute path to the official Codex executable. In auto mode, leave empty to search PATH and then the bundled runtime.

copilotCodexProvider.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for the explicitly selected model. Unsupported values are rejected instead of downgraded.

copilotCodexProvider.maxToolCalls.description: Maximum number of Copilot tool calls Codex may request in one response.

copilotCodexProvider.bridgeInputTokenBud.description: Approximate total token budget for the Copilot-to-Codex bridge prompt. Older messages are omitted only as complete tool-call/result groups, while the latest user instruction and newest evidence are retained.

copilotCodexProvider.modelMaxInputTokens.description: Input-token capacity advertised to VS Code.

copilotCodexProvider.modelMaxOutputToken.description: Output-token capacity advertised to VS Code.

copilotCodexProvider.logLevel.description: Extension log verbosity. Prompt content and credentials are never logged.

scripts.build: npm run check && node scripts/prepare-sdk-runtime.mjs && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke:extension && npm run smoke:sdk
scripts.package:thin: npm run validate && vsce package --ignoreFile .vscodeignore.thin --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out copilot-codex-provider-0.6.3-thin.vsix
scripts.package:full: npm run validate && node scripts/prepare-full-runtime.mjs && vsce package --target win32-x64 --ignoreFile .vscodeignore.full --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out copilot-codex-provider-0.6.3-win32-x64-full.vsix
scripts.package:all: npm run package:thin && npm run package:full
